answer_1.quote: Question answering (QA) over tabular data, commonly known as the TableQA task, is an important challenge in NLP. In this study, we targets TableQA to explore and enhance the proficiency of LLMs, in reasoning over tabular data.

answer_2.quote: Following prior works , we employ Exact Match Accuracy as the evaluation metric to validate predictions against ground truths, embedding instructions in prompts for consistent and parseable outputs.
